name: TUG-b13
description: The TUG-b13, also known as the quadrijet transfer spacetug and more commonly known simply as the quadjumper, was a type of spacetug manufactured by Sublights Products Corporation. A quadjumper was located at Niima Outpost some thirty years after the Battle of Endor, and Rey and Finn wanted to use the ship to escape the First Order's attack, but the quadjumper was destroyed by strafing runs before they could reach it.
